svg.title: Chatbot Application Localization and Customization
svg.desc: A 4200 by 2000 transparent English-language diagram using a restrained rose palette. Five stages take a Group Application Template on Assistant Chatbot Platform through BU application creation, configuration, extension and integration, validation and approval, and publishing and operations. Ten customization areas are arranged in two rows of five. They cover brand and language, dynamic UI and custom components, host application integration, identity and trusted context, conversations and sessions, Agent and resource bindings, actions and human handoff, nudges, guardrails and data governance, and testing, release and operations. AG-UI events, A2UI descriptions, component catalogs and renderers have distinct roles. Runtime enforcement and a versioned, compatible application release apply across all areas. A Malaysia Agency Portal client-meeting example connects verified host context to the BU Assistant Agent, Sales Domain Agent, dynamic business UI and authorized CRM or Calendar actions.

g.text: Verify Context · Authorize Access & Actions · Govern Outputs
Platform & business systems enforce Group + BU controls.
App Config · UI Catalog · SDK / Renderer · Policies · Agents & Resources
Test Compatibility → Approve → Publish → Monitor → Roll Back
Confirm → Authorize → Execute → Report Result · Local Nudge Rules
